note: Comanche County KS: no queryable zoning district service found. Coldwater (county seat, largest city) publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (DocumentCenter/View/174/Zoning-Map-PDF); the city's zoning ordinance is also a PDF. The county's maps page lists only road, commissioner, school and taxing-unit PDFs. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online and the Kansas ORKA/geoportal pages found no Comanche zoning layer. Protection and other towns publish no zoning service found. Only commercial parcel vendors (Rockford, acres) mention zoning fields.
